t: You're at the Tower Hill Sundial, a horizontal sundial that stands as a monument. It was made by Edwin Russell, an English sculptor who lived from 1939 to 2013. Russell was born in Heathfield, Sussex, and studied at the Brighton School of Art and then the Royal Academy School. So this is the work of a trained sculptor, and you can see it in how the piece is made. Look at the dial and at how it marks the hours.
